claim_policy: Circuit-verified, DSP-voiced. Synthetic consistency measurements and listening preferences do not establish hardware equivalence.

sources.raw_patch_and_midi: Emitted alongside every measurement as .syx and .mid files; per-rate sample offsets and fixed engine seeds are recorded in manifest.json.
sources.permitted_claim: Reproducibility, raw levels, cross-rate spectral and envelope behavior of the identified executable.
sources.not_evidence_for: Exact SH-201 oscillator, digital-filter or envelope algorithms.

sources.title: Roland SH-201 Owner's Manual
sources.provenance: Official Roland publication; catalogued in README.md.
sources.permitted_claim: Documented architecture, control semantics, routing and parameter ranges.
sources.not_evidence_for: Undocumented DSP transfer functions or calibration curves.

sources.title: Roland SH-201/SH-201C Service Notes, May 2006, 17058418E0
sources.circuit_observation: Active Sallen-Key output low-pass: 4.7k/8.2k resistors, 270pF feedback capacitor, 820pF capacitor to ground, op-amp gain 2.5 from 33k/22k with 10pF feedback capacitor. It is not a pair of independent passive RC poles.
sources.not_evidence_for: The WSP DSP's internal voice-filter topology or exact synthesis clock.

sources.permitted_claim: The documented device USB audio stream is 44.1kHz.
sources.not_evidence_for: A proven internal sample rate for every hardware synthesis block; the 44.1kHz reference-rate candidate remains provisional.

sources.bank_format: SH2LibrarianFile0000; binary librarian records, not a sequence of SysEx frames
sources.provenance: Official page groups downloadable patch data and named demonstrations. No bank or recording is committed to this repository.
known_unknowns: whether the exact downloadable revision was used
sources.permitted_claim: A stronger named patch/reference pairing than an unidentified wet demo, suitable for bounded character comparisons.
sources.not_evidence_for: A sample-aligned dry hardware calibration or a uniquely determined circuit/DSP model.

sources.permitted_claim: Recorded user preferences under the stated blind A-Z listening protocol.
sources.not_evidence_for: Closing an open hardware calibration question.
